title: Check radians first
task: Confirm that Desmos is in radian mode before any trigonometric value, derivative or integral.

steps.text: Open Graph Settings with the shortcut, which is Ctrl+Cmd+G on a Mac.
Read which of Radians and Degrees is selected, and select Radians if Degrees is selected.
The toggle shortcut, Ctrl+D on a Mac, flips the mode rather than setting it, so Graph Settings is read again after using it.

exam_habit.text: Numerical values of an integral or of a rate involving a trigonometric function computed in degree mode lose the first point they would have earned.

bluebook_note: The College Board list of changes names no change to the angle mode, while other testing calculators often open in Degrees, so the setting is read rather than assumed.

sources.anchor_quote: Open or Close the Graph Settings Menu | CTRL + ALT + G | CTRL + COMMAND + G
Toggle Between Degrees and Radians | ALT + D | CTRL + D
To switch to between degrees and radians, click Graph Settings and then toggle between Radians and Degrees.
The testing calculator's default angle mode is often set to degrees rather than radians.
Images, folders, and notes are disabled on your test.
(Note: Your calculator should be in radian mode.)
